[[File:Dexs_Diner.jpg|Right|250px|thumb|Dex's Diner.]]
{{Quote|Let's stop for something to eat. That restaurant over there looks good.|Young [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] to her bodyguards|<ref name="First Impressions">{{Tales|15|First Impressions (comic story)}}</ref>}}
A '''restaurant''' was a place of business where beings could purchase and eat food. One well-known example of such an establishment was [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
